rows.grounds: ablative singular of abstract compound noun expressing cause

items.question: Why does union follow immediately after?
premises: Both nature of Shiva and Shakti causes union.
items.inference: Immediate union arises from shared Shiva-Shakti nature.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic scope of iti remains unclear.
items.plain_english: Next, because it is of the nature of both Shiva and Shakti, there is union; thus.
